src/types/annotations.ts.description: Annotation type system uses discriminated unions with 'type' field as discriminator. Four annotation types: text (position + text), arrow (startPoint + endPoint), zone (shape + center + size), drawing (points array). Includes serialization for JSON persistence with Date to ISO string conversion.

src/components/Annotations/TextAnnotatio.description: TextAnnotation component uses @react-three/drei Text wrapped in Billboard for camera-facing readability. Text positioned at annotation.points[0] with height offset of 0.5 above field. Uses black outline for visibility on green field background.

src/components/Annotations/ArrowAnnotati.description: ArrowAnnotation component renders directional arrows using line segment with cone arrowhead. Uses bufferGeometry for line, coneGeometry for arrowhead. Cone rotation calculated via spherical coordinates (phi=acos(direction.y), theta=atan2(direction.x, direction.z)) with 'YXZ' Euler order. Cone positioned with -coneHeight/2 offset so tip is exactly at endpoint.

src/components/Scene/AnnotationLayer.tsx.description: AnnotationLayer now uses 4 dedicated component imports for all annotation types: TextAnnotation (text), ArrowAnnotation (arrow), ZoneAnnotation (circle & rectangle zones), DrawingAnnotation (line/free-hand). The inline rendering functions were removed in favor of these reusable components that provide better rendering (ZoneAnnotation uses filled geometry with transparency, DrawingAnnotation uses memoized bufferGeometry for efficient path rendering).

src/components/Annotations/DrawingAnnota.description: DrawingAnnotation component renders free-hand drawing paths using bufferGeometry with bufferAttribute. Points array is flattened into Float32Array using useMemo for performance. Requires minimum 2 points to render. Uses lineBasicMaterial with configurable color and linewidth from annotation.thickness.

src/hooks/useAnnotationInteraction.ts.description: useAnnotationInteraction hook handles different drawing behaviors per tool type. For 'line' tool (free-hand drawing), it captures continuous path with multiple intermediate points during pointer move, using a 0.5 unit minimum distance threshold to optimize point density. For 'arrow', 'circle', and 'rectangle' tools, it only keeps start and end points (two-point behavior). Points are stored in currentPointsRef.current array and annotation is created on pointer up.

src/components/Annotations/.description: All annotation components (TextAnnotation, ArrowAnnotation, ZoneAnnotation) now implement draggable handles following the Player.tsx pattern. Uses useFrame with raycaster.setFromCamera and ray.intersectPlane for smooth ground-plane dragging. DragHandle component provides reusable sphere handles with hover/active states. Zones can be moved by dragging the fill area, and resized via corner/edge handles.
